title: Phase-controlled bipartite and tripartite entanglement and Bell nonlocality in a closed-loop optomechanical system
summary: We propose a novel scheme to generate and manipulate bipartite and tripartite entanglement and Bell nonlocality in a closed-loop three-mode optomechanical system, where two optical modes are simultaneously coupled to a mechanical mode via typical optomechanical interactions and also coupled to each other through field transmission. This configuration gives rise to a phase-sensitive coupling, in which the relative phase directly controls the population distribution between two optical modes, enabling coherent redistribution of quantum correlations.
